decoding: Raw global-vocabulary greedy argmax, no sampling or logit processors; official full forward, full-prefix recomputation, use_cache=false.
primary: Completed native-EOS response containing only an integer with the correct value.
secondary: Complete first-integer and last-integer parses, both reported with raw responses. Never choose one parser after seeing outcomes.
parity: One official full-forward prefill must reproduce the archived manual-text/head letter logits within rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-3 and the same offered-letter winner.
scope_limit: Calibration diagnosis, two reused identity groups, eight-token response cap. Truncation and format failure do not establish inability to perform arithmetic.
fitting: No optimizer, adapter or model update; no action execution.
